title: Dereth Town Tour - Redspire scratch

shots.standingOrder: Hover over the golden sea south-west of Redspire looking straight down at the waves, then tilt up while drifting in to reveal the hilltop town and its Viamontian tower.
shots.notes: ESTABLISHING + WATER (drone.tilt-reveal). Hovers 45 m over the sea 190 m SW of the hilltop town, starting at -80 deg on the golden-lit waves, then tilts up to level while drifting 12 m in: the sea cliffs, the green hill and Redspire with its gold-roofed Viamontian tower appear; the low golden sun (west, 38 deg) behind-left front-lights the town. Verified offline (real registry build + WBT terrain): start (4421.0,34084.4,45.0) end (4427.9,34094.2,45.0), min AGL 45.0 m, nearest static/building/tree 32.9 m (0x02000A38@4424,34070), peak 1.3 m/s; WBT get-height at 5 path samples matched the checker terrain to 0.00 m.

shots.standingOrder: Rise slowly in front of the captured Viamontian banner field while the ring of fire orbits its base, the golden-roofed tower behind.
shots.notes: FLAME (classic.pedestal). 11 m south of the captured Viamontian banner field (0x02000ABE, 8.9 m gold-and-blue banner) where a ring of fire puffs orbits (0x02000B22): rise from 3 m to 10 m keeping aim, the banner on the left third and the 25 m stone tower 48 m behind; golden side light from the west. shots.standingOrder: Look down 42 degrees from above the huts at the glowing Life Stone and the Town Network portal side by side, pushing in gently.
shots.notes: PARTICLE FX (classic.high-angle, assigned). shots.standingOrder: Crouch below the shattered Portal to Nanto and look up as lightning arcs crackle around its crystal against the golden sky.
shots.notes: LIGHTNING FX (classic.low-angle). Lens 0.7 m above the slope 10 m WNW of the shattered Portal to Nanto (crystal 0x02000B61) where crackling arc clusters (0x02000B6F) and arc fountains (0x020007C5) spit bolts; looking up 11-13 deg with a 1.5 m push, the golden sun behind the camera lighting the crystal against the hill and Redspire above. Camera stays ~6 m outside the 4.3 m bolt reach. shots.notes: CLOSING (drone.pano-360).
